npcs.name: VF 5,7,8 D Old Guy Neighbour
npcs.meet_text: Out in the forest too hey? I'm glad they managed to reopen it today, the storm we had last week was really bad.
npcs.repeat_text: If I was younger I'd do a daily run in here. It's always cool with the shade of the trees and there's a lot of water with all the ponds.

npcs.name: Pikachu Mum
npcs.meet_text: All my kids always wander off and don't come back for a while. They love looking for Pikachu around here but have never found one. If you see any of them could you tell them to come back here please?
npcs.repeat_text: All my kids are dressed up as Pikachu, from a distance you might mistake them for an actual Pikachu!! If you can get them all to come back here I'd appreciate it.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
npcs.meet_text: I've never even been on a surfboard before.
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could surf like a Pikachu!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
npcs.meet_text: I've still not seen a Pikachu fly!
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could go flying toooo.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
npcs.meet_text: I've been taking some good pictures on my camera recently.
npcs.repeat_text: I'm still working on my Pikachu picture collection. I currently don't have many.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
npcs.meet_text: I've still got my eyes open trying to find a Pikachu here!
npcs.repeat_text: Please tell me if you find a Pikachu running around here!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
npcs.meet_text: Thunderbolt is such a super duper powerful attack.
npcs.repeat_text: I would never want to be shocked by a real Thunderbolt!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
npcs.repeat_text: I love Pikachu the most out of all of us!

npcs.name: VF 5,7,8 D,E Rocket Pack Gift
npcs.meet_text: I'm glad we can finally get our hands on these packs. You look like you haven't opened many of these so have one on me. Spread the word you can buy them here.
npcs.repeat_text: Hope you pulled something good from that.

npcs.name: VF 5-8 D Wishing Well Coin Thrower
npcs.meet_text: I always come here to throw a coin in the well and make a wish but they never come true. Maybe if I give this to you instead it'll work better.
npcs.repeat_text: You could always try making a wish by throwing a coin in yourself.

condition.target: VF 5-8 D Wishing Well Coin Thrower

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever seen a Pikachu Surf, Some are really really good on a surfboard!!
opponents.repeat_text: Have you seen a Pikachu on a surfboard yet?
opponents.first_win_text: If you haven't seen a Pikachu use surf you can have this then!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wish I could surf like a Pikachu
opponents.loss_text: Pikachu can do everything, it's the best!!!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
opponents.meet_text: Some Pokemon can use fly to take you somewhere you want to go. Turns out so can Pikachu!
opponents.repeat_text: I want to take a ride on a flying Pikachu
opponents.first_win_text: Hold onto this and try not to float away!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I've never see a flying Pikachu
opponents.loss_text: You'll never catch a Pikachu that's flying away!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
opponents.meet_text: I love taking pictures of Pokemon, especially Pikachu!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm really good with a Camera!
opponents.first_win_text: I took a really good picture of Pikachu and put it on this card
opponents.rematch_win_text: Do you want to see more pictures of Pikachu?
opponents.loss_text: I'll have to take a photo to remember this moment

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
opponents.meet_text: Did you know Pikachu live in the forest?
opponents.repeat_text: I've not seen any Pikachu around here yet.
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could find a Pikachu around here but this is all I can find.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Have you found a Pikachu around here yet?
opponents.loss_text: If I'm lucky enough to win then I should be lucky enough to see a Pikachu!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
opponents.meet_text: Go Pikachu, use Thunderbolt!!!.... I don't really have a Pikachu.
opponents.repeat_text: I wish I could have a Pikachu for real
opponents.first_win_text: Have this Pikachu card and if you get a real Pikachu can you let me have it?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I still don't have a Pikachu at all
opponents.loss_text: My Pikachu would be really strong too!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
opponents.meet_text: Pikachu is just so cute, he's the cutest Pokemon ever!
opponents.first_win_text: Even though I don't have a lot of Pikachu, you can have this one.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I will win with my Pikachu one day!
opponents.loss_text: That's why I love Pikachu so much!

opponents.name: Pikachu Mum
opponents.meet_text: Thank you for getting them all to come back and stay here, I don't know the rules very well of this game but I'll play you as a thanks!
opponents.repeat_text: Want to see all of my Pikachu again?
opponents.first_win_text: As a thank you again, take these!
opponents.rematch_win_text: My kids could learn a lot from you
opponents.loss_text: I didn't know Pikachu could be so strong!

opponents.name: Youngster Cooper
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever seen a pokemon EXPLODE before? It's CRAZY!
opponents.repeat_text: I PROMISE I haven't blown anything up!!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I feel like I'm going to explode

opponents.name: Backpacker Patrick
opponents.meet_text: I've been all over the world and seen a lot of different places.
opponents.repeat_text: Nothing like putting on a backpack and going exploring
opponents.loss_text: Carrying all this weight makes me stronger in every sense

opponents.name: Fossil Expert Jonathan
opponents.meet_text: There's a lot of history in this forest, it's been around for thousands of years.
opponents.repeat_text: You haven't found any mysterious artifacts around here have you?
opponents.first_win_text: We can learn a lot of things from the past.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Even losses are a great way to learn.
opponents.loss_text: You're a thing of the past!

opponents.name: Card Expert Ruby
opponents.meet_text: You have to be careful with fire in the forest!!! They're only cards though so it's completely fine!
opponents.repeat_text: I've been practicing safety since we last met.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I might try using water instead of fire, I might have better luck with that.
opponents.loss_text: Don't play with fire if you don't know what you're doing.

opponents.name: Nature Lover Erin
opponents.meet_text: I absolutely love the forest in the day, it's my favourite spot to hang out.
opponents.repeat_text: Nothing like being out in the open air hey?
opponents.first_win_text: Nothing can bring me down when I'm in such a good mood.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You don't always have to go so hard, sometimes you can just relax.
opponents.loss_text: Take a moment to breathe and try again!

opponents.name: Gentleman Benedict
opponents.meet_text: Good day. I'm not the most youthful but I love a good match.
opponents.repeat_text: Hello again, up for another match ey?
opponents.first_win_text: Hoh, hoh, very well played there.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Another jolly good show old chum.
opponents.loss_text: At least with age comes experience!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Misty
opponents.meet_text: This bridge really reminds me of home. I'm Misty, the Ex Gym Leader of Cerulean. I'm known for my all out Water-type offensive. This is only a practice but I won't hold back and we'll still play by the banned trainer cards rules.
opponents.repeat_text: I haven't got time to go swimming today so do you want another match?
opponents.first_win_text: You really are strong and skilled!
opponents.rematch_win_text: Glad to see you're really learning a thing or two!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Erika
opponents.meet_text: Hello, such pleasant weather here, I'm afraid I may doze off... My name is Erika. I was the leader of Celadon Gym. If you want a match with me you'll need to make sure you don't use any banned trainer cards.
opponents.repeat_text: Plants are such delicate things. The amount of water, the condition of the soil, the temperature differences, the changing weather can have such a huge effect. Sorry.. you want another match?
opponents.first_win_text: That was a delightful match. I felt inspired
opponents.rematch_win_text: Losing leaves a bitter aftertaste... But knowing that there are strong players spurs me to do better...
